newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Csopak boosts stake in Forum Rt.
newsitem.headline: Csopak boosts stake in Forum Rt.

text.p: Hungarian holding firm Csopak Rt said on Wednesday that it had increased its stake to 55.7 percent from 46.6 percent in Forum Kereskedelmi es Idegenforgalmi Rt trading company.
Csopak boosted its stake in Forum on March 3 by subscribing a nominal 30 million forint share package issued privately, Csopak said in the official bourse gazette.
Forum's issued share capital rose to 177 million as a result of the new share issue.
On Monday Csopak said it had acquired 100 percent of Chance 96 Kft which holds 99.94 percent of the retail trading company Pannonker Kft. -- Budapest newsroom +36 1 327-4040
